name: pdf_to_images_converter
description: Convert a source document (a PDF, or a single uploaded image: PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, or GIF) into optimized page images for AI analysis. When page_numbers is supplied, rasterizes only those PDF pages. Use after native PDF routing, never as the default for every PDF page. An image input is only normalized, never rasterized.

document_path.description: S3 URL (s3://bucket/key) or absolute file path to the source document to process. May be a PDF or a single image (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, GIF).

max_image_size_mb.description: Maximum size limit for each generated image in megabytes. Default: 4.0

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch for PDF-to-image rasterization. Ignored for image inputs. Default: 128

page_numbers.description: Optional one-indexed PDF pages to render. Omit only when every page must be rasterized.

aws_profile.description: Optional AWS profile name for authentication.

job_id.description: Identifier of the analysis run this invocation belongs to. Pass through the job_id supplied in the orchestrator context. Omit only when no analysis run is active.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the source document being analysed. Pass through the doc_id supplied in the orchestrator context.

result.description: JSON object with: images (array of S3 paths), pages (array of page_number and image_path mappings), page_count (rendered-page count), and session_id. Preserve page_number when dispatching downstream.
